quest.title: New Idea
quest.description: Ginette tweaks the recovered robots, and a new possibility blooms for her research...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Thanks to your help, I've finished making adjustments to the robots you found previously.

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: So far, I haven't run into any new problems, but what I have run into is a new idea...

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: #When you track down the other robots, {NICKNAME}, can you pay attention to any of their special behaviors?

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Well, that'd be... how they interact with each other, I suppose? Ah, it should be much more obvious once we've recovered enough of them.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay... Well, leave it to us!

dialogues.speaker: Ginette
dialogues.text: Thank you both! I'll mark the next area on your map...
